canonical_project: Bavarian Green Data Center (BGDC), University of Passau
owner: University of Passau; Bavarian State Ministry for Digital Affairs
notes: Official state and university releases describe a cooperation agreement (2023-06-07) for the Bavarian Green Data Center model project on the University of Passau campus: prefabricated expandable server container with greenhouse heat reuse, ministry funding around EUR 3 million; presented at Woche der Umwelt. Construction/operation status not yet confirmed publicly, so status kept as planned.
